info.title: Pico S/Pro Standalone API
info.description: Local appliance API implemented by src/local_api.c. Experimental reconstructed firmware; hardware behavior and timing still require bench validation. The appliance serves HTTP on its LAN address with a separately provisioned bearer key. API calls are bounded to 4095 body bytes, one connection at a time; Content-Length and application/json are required for POST, PUT and PATCH. Chunked transfer, CORS, cookies and query parameters other than the documented history id are unsupported. Recipes/settings and the local session counter use CRC-checked, readback-verified two-bank SLFS records. Recent events are an eight-entry RAM ring. Brew history is stored on the Pico in a bounded shared flash pool and survives normal restarts; the oldest completed histories are retired as space is needed. 503 on a write can mean commit verification failed after data was written: read the resource before retrying. Calls that start workflows return acceptance, not completion.

servers.description: Pico LAN address; use a trusted isolated LAN or an external TLS tunnel.

device.description: Appliance IP address, optionally with port.

get.description: Only this GET API route is public. It reveals no credentials or temperatures.

get.summary: Read controller, workflow and front-panel state
get.description: Foreground snapshot. ready=false suppresses sensor values. Reading status does not energize outputs.

put.summary: Create or replace a persisted recipe while idle
put.description: The old committed recipe remains referenced while the inactive data and catalog banks are written. A first-ever torn catalog initialization fails closed, preserving files for recovery. Existing appliance menus can select these local recipes.

delete.description: No request body. Commits catalog removal; freed slots are reused without formatting or deleting unrelated flash files.

post.summary: Queue a workflow or operate the virtual front panel

get.summary: Read the recent volatile event ring
get.description: Contains at most eight recent events since boot, in sequence order. Old events are overwritten. Persistent brew samples and session metadata are available from /api/v1/history. Persistent session IDs use a separately committed monotonically increasing counter.

get.summary: List retained brews and recording capacity
get.description: Recorded automatically on the Pico, independent of HTTP clients or Wi-Fi association. Regular snapshots every 15 seconds plus phase/step/status transitions. A current RAM tail is checkpointed at most every 60 seconds while foreground storage is available. A restart marks an unfinished session interrupted; uncommitted readings may be lost. The truncated and storage_error flags identify incomplete histories. Only brewing/manual brewing workflows are recorded; settings and maintenance do not replace them.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based row offset; follow next_offset until null.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id from the retained session metadata. This prevents combining samples from different brews.

get.summary: Read a page of recorded brew samples
get.description: At most 32 rows per response. A removed or unknown session id returns 409; refresh the inventory instead of combining pages. An offset equal to record_count returns an empty page. JSON/CSV export is assembled by clients from these pages; the device never builds an entire log in RAM.

get.summary: Read optional telemetry destination and delivery status
get.description: Forwarding defaults off. When enabled the Pico sends best-effort status snapshots to the configured HTTP host/port. Local history and brewing continue independently. Counters are since boot. Hostname resolution is performed only while idle; socket progress is nonblocking and bounded. There is no historical backlog upload.

200.description: Saved configuration and current forwarding status

put.summary: Configure optional telemetry forwarding while idle
put.description: Supply all three fields. Persists two CRC/readback-verified configuration records. Use an IP address or hostname, not a URL. Fixed receiver path /api/v1/telemetry, HTTP only, default port8080. Provider secrets and the Pico API key are never sent to this receiver.

200.description: Saved configuration and current forwarding status

post.summary: Add missing starter PicoPak recipes while idle
post.description: No request body. Content-Type: application/json and Content-Length: 0 are required. Preserves existing IDs including edited defaults. Checks free slots before writing; verifies all new recipe records before one catalogue commit. Read the catalogue after an uncertain 503 before retrying.

200.description: Starter recipes present; existing IDs preserved

507.description: Not enough free recipe slots to add all missing starters

bearerAuth.description: Provision /local/api.key separately. Missing/invalid key returns 401; unprovisioned API returns 503 except public health. Plain HTTP does not encrypt the key; limit use to a trusted LAN or add TLS externally.

message.description: Human-readable explanation; present for dispatcher errors, omitted by the transport.

RecipeId.description: Client-selected stable, case-sensitive ID. No path separators or URL escapes.

location.description: Existing firmware's brewing compartment number; preserve appliance plumbing semantics.

target_f.description: Fahrenheit; 0 means unheated. Nonzero targets must be 60–212.

minutes.description: Active hold duration in minutes after reaching the target; 0 preserves native PicoPak heating-only steps. Requires zero_minute_steps capability.

RecipeInput.description: Complete recipe replacement. Optional id must match the URL. All labels are printable ASCII, matching the appliance font. Unknown/duplicate JSON fields, fractional numbers, and escaped control characters are rejected.

SettingsPatch.description: Partial update, accepted only at the main menu. Wi-Fi credentials, calibration, API key, and raw outputs are not settings in this API.

firmware_version.description: Running firmware release as major.minor.patch, independent of api_version.

uptime_ms.description: Milliseconds since boot; wraps at 2^32. No wall clock is assumed.

firmware_version.description: Running firmware release as major.minor.patch, independent of api_version.

zero_minute_steps.description: Accepts zero-minute heating-only steps. Absent on older firmware; clients must not alter native durations to bypass validation.

command.description: Current control context: initializing, idle, front-panel, or a dispatched remote program name. A 202 response acknowledges queuing; the command name changes when dispatched.

phase.description: Recovered controller phase code; raw numeric code retained to avoid guessing semantics.

wort_f.description: Wort sensor Fahrenheit, rounded to one decimal; null before initialization or for nonfinite/out-of-range values.

step_seconds.description: Current controller step counter; not a wall-clock timestamp.

stop_reason.description: Reason for latched output inhibition; clear-stop requires the main-menu boundary.

data.description: 1024 raw panel-order bytes as lowercase hex. Raw pixel (x,y) is bit (y & 7) of byte x + floor(y / 8) * 128. The Pico uses a fixed 180-degree graphics rotation: upright screen pixel (x,y) reads raw pixel (127-x,63-y). Clients must apply that orientation; the API returns the raw framebuffer unchanged.

EncoderCommand.description: Virtual rotary encoder movement and/or one click. A zero delta with no click is rejected. Uses the existing screen/menu flow and its prompts.

CommandRequest.description: Start commands queue until the main-menu boundary. No raw output, temperature override, or unattended prompt bypass. stop latches output inhibition; clear-stop succeeds only after returning to the main menu. Dedicated pause/resume is unavailable; use the virtual front panel.

sessions.description: Retained sessions in newest-first order. The top-level metadata repeats the current/latest session. Total sample storage is shared; eight is a catalog limit, not a guarantee of eight complete brews.

samples.description: Each row follows the fields array from GET /history. Temperatures are degrees Fahrenheit or null if unavailable; 255 means an unknown current_step. Flags: ready=1, busy=2, stopped=4, filter inserted=8, sampling gap=16. Recorded times are elapsed milliseconds, without an assumed wall clock.

host.description: IPv4 address or ASCII hostname, without scheme, path, credentials or port. Empty is allowed only when disabled.
IPv4 address or ASCII hostname, without scheme, path, credentials or port. Empty is allowed only when disabled.

TelemetryUpload.description: Outbound JSON sent to the separately configured HTTP receiver. This is not an inbound POST route on the Pico. No device API key is included.

BadRequest.description: Invalid or duplicate fields, malformed JSON, invalid ID, or unsupported command.

MethodNotAllowed.description: Resource exists but this method is unsupported.

Conflict.description: Appliance busy, stop latched, or command not safe in current workflow state.

Unavailable.description: Not ready, bearer key unprovisioned, storage I/O error, or corrupt records preserved for recovery. Read before retrying an uncertain write.

Full.description: Sixteen local recipe slots are occupied or a generation counter is exhausted.

ProtocolError.description: Bounded HTTP transport or dispatcher rejected the request (e.g. 408, 411, 413, 415, 431, 500 or 501).
